# SVG to Video Studio

> High-fidelity, browser-based SVG to video Studio and CLI converter. Transforms CSS-animated SVGs into MP4, WebM, GIF, and aPNG with alpha-channel transparency.

## Core Resources

- [Web Studio](https://gehdoc.github.io/svg-to-video/): Interactive in-browser converter interface.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/GehDoc/svg-to-video): Source code, issue tracker, and main documentation.
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gehdoc/svg-to-video): CLI tool and programmatic Node.js API.
- [Docker Image](https://hub.docker.com/r/gehdoc/svg-to-video): Headless containerized rendering environment.
- [MCP Server Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers/io.github.GehDoc%2Fsvg-to-video/versions/latest): Official Model Context Protocol registration for AI agents.

## Documentation & Guides

- [README Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GehDoc/svg-to-video/main/README.md): Complete usage guide, CLI arguments, and options.
- [MCP Integration Guide](https://github.com/GehDoc/svg-to-video#model-context-protocol-mcp-server): How to connect the agent skill to Claude Desktop or Cursor.

## Key Capabilities

- Supports MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, aPNG, and GIF exports.
- Full alpha-channel transparency support for WebM, aPNG, and GIF.
- Frame-accurate Web Animations API scrubbing.
- Metadata injection (Title and Comment) into exported video files.
- 100% serverless, client-side rendering privacy in the browser.
